svg.text: Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow an audit request from the portal to evidence, findings, and weekly status.
The auditor signs in through Cognito (auditors group) and opens the engagement portal.
The portal handler records each PBC request with an owner, a due date, and a status.
Control owners upload evidence through the portal to the engagement evidence bucket.
The upload event runs the intake marker, which marks the PBC request received.
Findings move through Step Functions states: open, planned, remediated, validated, closed.
Each day Scheduler runs the reminder, which reads overdue PBC items and findings.
SES emails each control owner the items that are past their SLA.
Each week the status report Lambda summarizes requests and findings into a report.
Status reports land in S3 and are sent to stakeholders, who read but cannot edit.
KMS encrypts engagement evidence; CloudWatch alarms on failed runs.
